{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Stalking Moon''''' was a [[Yorik-stronha]], a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Spy/Legends|spyship]], assigned in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] to the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Qurang Lah]] and tasked to spearhead the [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (26 ABY)|impending invasion]] of the [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]].

Externally, the ''Stalking Moon'' was a relatively large ship, but the nickel-iron shell which disguised it as an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] was fifty meters deep in most places, and most of the hull enclosed within this shell was taken up with propulsion systems. The actual habitable areas were small, sited beneath a twenty-meter fissure in the crust which masked the ship's cooling vanes, and the crew consisted of just seven [[Warrior caste|warriors]], two [[Shaper caste|shapers]] and several [[Shamed Ones]] to deal with the less salubrious aspects of the ship's operations.

As the fleet gathered for the attack on Yag'Dhul, the ''Stalking Moon'' was captured by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Solo]], [[Tahiri Veila]] and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]. Tahiri, who had been conditioned with a working knowledge of Yuuzhan Vong biotechnology as part of an attempt by the invaders to brainwash her, was able to pilot the ship, and the Jedi alerted the Givin before the attack began.
